style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.fd_messenger: A figure in a costume covered with tiny bells stumbling along a road at night toward a campfire, ribbons trailing behind in the dark
pictures.fd_messenger_2: A wax-sealed letter lying on dark grass beside a still hand in a jingling glove, popcorn and confetti scattered around it
pictures.fd_unfolds: A wide shot of a small village swollen to twice its size, every roof strung with green, red and gold ribbon, bonfires in the lanes, an orange moon behind
pictures.fd_unfolds_2: A square town green turned square, a tall maypole at its centre topped by a leering clown balloon, a small wooden jester backflipping on its peak
pictures.fd_dream: A manor on a hill in impossible daylight under a sun with a painted clown's face, the sky a bright wrong blue
pictures.fd_dream_2: The clown sun laughing until blood runs from its nose, then falling in a wall of fire onto a quiet valley
pictures.fd_unmasking: Two porcelain harlequin masks cracking down the middle in a crowd of costumed dancers, confetti in the air
pictures.fd_unmasking_2: A thin lord and a young woman smiling through paint like blood, their harlequin masks in pieces at their feet
pictures.fd_unmasking_3: Two figures bursting into long streamers that scatter on the wind over a festival square
pictures.fd_balloon_rises: A maypole tearing out of packed earth as a vast clown balloon lifts, ribbons whipping, the crowd below staring up
pictures.fd_balloon_rises_2: A painted balloon mouth opening and moving as if to speak, lit gold by bonfires
pictures.fd_shows_over: A small wooden jester marionette with its head popped off lying on packed earth, a rod in its wooden hands
pictures.fd_shows_over_2: A clown balloon shrinking into the night sky and bursting into a firework in the shape of a leering face
pictures.fd_shows_over_3: Morning on empty streets of ordinary size, confetti in the gutters, villagers waving at an empty road as if a troupe were leaving
